summary: Backend + frontend regression for iter55. Backend: new pytest file tests/test_tool_documents.py (8 tests) covers POST add → PATCH rename → GET-refetch persistence → DELETE → DELETE-verify, plus 400 (empty name) + 404 (unknown doc / unknown tool) edge cases — 8/8 PASSED on the Pro account. Frontend: logged in to mechanicltz@gmail.com (Pro) by injecting JWT into AsyncStorage key 'tt.auth.token' (login button tap is flaky on web preview), then opened tool 'Injector seal installer kit' (e659d60a-…). Verified: kebab present (tool-menu-btn), Warranty tab → edit-warranty-link enters in-place edit on same screen (no navigation to /tool/edit) and renders edit-save-bar + edit-cancel-bar at the very top with the old bottom save bar absent; Photos tab gallery-delete-0 badge present; Documents tab add-document-btn / receipt-delete-0 / doc-rename-{id} all present; tapping doc-rename-{id} opens the rename modal with doc-rename-input + doc-rename-save + doc-rename-cancel all visible (see screenshot i55_e_renamemodal.png). more-bundles testID confirmed absent in (tabs)/more (grep + DOM query). Back-btn present on Dealers/Claims/Borrowers/More and absent on Dashboard (already confirmed in iteration_54). The Documents add-source prompt is implemented via React Native Alert.alert which on the web preview surfaces as a non-DOM browser alert (no crash, but text not readable via document.body.innerText); the testID add-document-btn fires the handler cleanly. Vault Notifications + Claims stat boxes no-drop-shadow checks are visual-only and were not deep-verified, but no shadow-related runtime errors appeared. Bundle 'Set Report' PDF export was previously verified passing in iteration_54.

minor.issue: routes_tool_actions.py:180 calls str(uuid.uuid4()) but the 'uuid' module is not imported in that file (only 'from typing import ...' etc.). Dead code in practice because Document.id has a default_factory that always assigns a UUID before this line runs — however a malicious / unusual client POSTing {'id': ''} would crash with NameError. Recommend either `import uuid` at the top of routes_tool_actions.py or remove the redundant str(uuid.uuid4()) fallback.
